name: Damac Harbour Lights
overview: Damac Harbour Lights is a unique residential project developed by one of the leading real estate companies in the UAE Damac Properties. This 54-storey marvel nested in the heart of Mina Rashid Dubai, offers a blend of luxury comfort and breathtaking views.The development offers 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each meticulously designed to offer a unique perspective on contemporary luxury. The design of each apartment is a testament to Damac Properties' commitment to providing residents with the highest level of elegance and sophistication. The apartments come with spacious balconies, offering residents a chance to enjoy the breathtaking cityscape of Dubai. The tranquillity of the location coupled with the clean air and natural beauty surrounding the area, make Damac Harbour Lights a haven for those seeking an extraordinary living experience.
